```{r}
cat("\n========== OUTLIER DETECTION ==========\n")

Q1 <- quantile(avocado$AveragePrice, 0.25)
Q3 <- quantile(avocado$AveragePrice, 0.75)
IQR <- Q3 - Q1
lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR

outliers_count <- sum(avocado$AveragePrice < lower_bound | avocado$AveragePrice > upper_bound)
cat("Outliers detected:", outliers_count, "(", round(outliers_count/nrow(avocado)*100, 2), "%)\n")

# Flag outliers but KEEP them
avocado <- avocado %>%
  mutate(
    is_outlier = ifelse(
      AveragePrice < lower_bound | AveragePrice > upper_bound,
      1, 0
    )
  )
```
```{r}
cat("\n========== FEATURE ENGINEERING ==========\n")

# Create aggregate features
avocado <- avocado %>%
  mutate(
    # Bag percentages
    Bags_Percentage = (Total.Bags / Total.Volume) * 100,
    Small_Bags_Pct = (Small.Bags / Total.Bags) * 100,
    Large_Bags_Pct = (Large.Bags / Total.Bags) * 100,
    XLarge_Bags_Pct = (XLarge.Bags / Total.Bags) * 100,
    
    # Handle division by zero
    Small_Bags_Pct = ifelse(is.na(Small_Bags_Pct), 0, Small_Bags_Pct),
    Large_Bags_Pct = ifelse(is.na(Large_Bags_Pct), 0, Large_Bags_Pct),
    XLarge_Bags_Pct = ifelse(is.na(XLarge_Bags_Pct), 0, XLarge_Bags_Pct),
    
    # Total PLU volume
    Total_PLU_Volume = `X4046` + `X4225` + `X4770`
  )

# Create seasonal features
avocado <- avocado %>%
  mutate(
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c("Dec", "Jan", "Feb") ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c("Mar", "Apr", "May") ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c("Jun", "Jul", "Aug") ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c("Sep", "Oct", "Nov") ~ "Fall"
    ),
    is_holiday_season = ifelse(
      month %in% c("Nov", "Dec") | (month == "Jan" & day(Date) <= 7),
      TRUE, FALSE
    ),
    is_summer = ifelse(month %in% c("Jun", "Jul", "Aug"), TRUE, FALSE)
  )

# TIME SERIES FEATURES - LAG VARIABLES
cat("\nCreating time series lag features...\n")

avocado <- avocado %>%
  arrange(region, Date) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  mutate(
    # Price lags
    price_lag_1 = lag(AveragePrice, 1),
    price_lag_2 = lag(AveragePrice, 2),
    price_lag_3 = lag(AveragePrice, 3),
    price_lag_4 = lag(AveragePrice, 4),
    price_lag_8 = lag(AveragePrice, 8),
    
    # Volume lags
    volume_lag_1 = lag(Total.Volume, 1),
    volume_lag_2 = lag(Total.Volume, 2),
    
    # Price changes
    price_change_1 = AveragePrice - price_lag_1,
    price_change_2 = AveragePrice - price_lag_2,
    price_change_pct = (AveragePrice - price_lag_1) / price_lag_1 * 100,
    
    # Rolling statistics (4-week window)
    rolling_mean_4 = rollmean(AveragePrice, k = 4, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    rolling_sd_4 = rollapply(AveragePrice, width = 4, FUN = sd, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    rolling_max_4 = rollapply(AveragePrice, width = 4, FUN = max, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    rolling_min_4 = rollapply(AveragePrice, width = 4, FUN = min, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    
    # Year-over-year price
    price_yoy = AveragePrice - lag(AveragePrice, 52)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create interaction features
avocado <- avocado %>%
  mutate(
    type_region = paste(type, region, sep = "_"),
    volume_category = case_when(
      Total.Volume < quantile(Total.Volume, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Low",
      Total.Volume < quantile(Total.Volume, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ "High"
    )
  )

cat("Features created successfully.\n")
cat("Total features:", ncol(avocado), "\n")
```
```{r}
cat("\n========== CORRELATION ANALYSIS ==========\n")

numeric_cols <- avocado %>%
  select(
    AveragePrice, Total.Volume, Total.Bags, Small.Bags, Large.Bags, XLarge.Bags,
    X4046, X4225, X4770, Bags_Percentage, Small_Bags_Pct,
    price_lag_1, price_lag_2, price_lag_3, price_lag_4,
    rolling_mean_4, rolling_sd_4
  ) %>%
  na.omit()

cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_cols, use = "complete.obs")

corrplot(cor_matrix, 
         method = "color", 
         type = "upper",
         tl.col = "black",
         tl.srt = 45,
         title = "Correlation Matrix of Avocado Features",
         mar = c(0,0,2,0))

highly_correlated <- which(abs(cor_matrix) > 0.8 & abs(cor_matrix) < 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
cat("\nHighly correlated feature pairs (>0.8):\n")
if (length(highly_correlated) > 0) {
  for (i in 1:min(5, nrow(highly_correlated))) {
    row <- highly_correlated[i, 1]
    col <- highly_correlated[i, 2]
    if (row < col) {
      cat("  ", rownames(cor_matrix)[row], "&", colnames(cor_matrix)[col], 
          ": ", round(cor_matrix[row, col], 3), "\n")
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
cat("\n========== DATA SPLITTING ==========\n")

model_data <- avocado %>%
  select(
    Date,
    AveragePrice,
    Total.Volume,
    type,
    region,
    year,
    month,
    season,
    day_of_week,
    Bags_Percentage,
    Small_Bags_Pct,
    is_holiday_season,
    is_summer,
    price_lag_1,
    price_lag_2,
    price_lag_3,
    price_lag_4,
    rolling_mean_4,
    rolling_sd_4,
    price_change_1,
    price_yoy,
    is_outlier
  ) %>%
  na.omit()

cat("Model data dimensions:", dim(model_data), "\n")

# Chronological split
set.seed(123)
n <- nrow(model_data)
train_end <- floor(n * 0.7)
valid_end <- floor(n * 0.85)

train_data <- model_data[1:train_end, ]
valid_data <- model_data[(train_end + 1):valid_end, ]
test_data <- model_data[(valid_end + 1):n, ]

cat("Training set:", nrow(train_data), "rows (", round(nrow(train_data)/n*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("Validation set:", nrow(valid_data), "rows (", round(nrow(valid_data)/n*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("Test set:", nrow(test_data), "rows (", round(nrow(test_data)/n*100, 1), "%)\n")

cat("Date ranges:\n")
cat("  Train:", format(min(train_data$Date), "%Y-%m-%d"), "to", 
    format(max(train_data$Date), "%Y-%m-%d"), "\n")
cat("  Valid:", format(min(valid_data$Date), "%Y-%m-%d"), "to", 
    format(max(valid_data$Date), "%Y-%m-%d"), "\n")
cat("  Test:", format(min(test_data$Date), "%Y-%m-%d"), "to", 
    format(max(test_data$Date), "%Y-%m-%d"), "\n")
```

ARIMA TIME SERIES MODELING
```{r}
# Fix avocado dates if needed
if(!inherits(avocado$Date, "Date") || min(avocado$Date, na.rm = TRUE) < 0) {
  avocado <- avocado %>%
    mutate(
      Date = as.Date(Date, origin = "1899-12-30")
    )
  cat("Fixed avocado dates\n")
}

region_name <- "California"
region_data <- avocado %>%
  filter(region == region_name) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(month_name = month(Date, label = TRUE))

cat("Date range:", min(region_data$Date), "to", max(region_data$Date), "\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(region_data), "\n")
```

```{r}
# PHASE 3: ARIMA TIME SERIES MODELING
cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("PHASE 3: ARIMA TIME SERIES MODELING\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# Prepare data
region_name <- "California"

region_data <- avocado %>%
  filter(region == region_name) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Date),
    month_name = month(Date, label = TRUE)
  )

cat("Data period:", min(region_data$Date), "to", max(region_data$Date), "\n")
cat("Number of weeks:", nrow(region_data), "\n")
cat("Average price:", round(mean(region_data$AveragePrice), 3), "\n")

# Create time series
ts_data <- ts(
  region_data$AveragePrice,
  start = c(2015, 1),
  frequency = 52
)

cat("\nTime Series Object:\n")
cat("  Start:", start(ts_data), "\n")
cat("  End:", end(ts_data), "\n")
cat("  Frequency:", frequency(ts_data), "weeks/year\n")
cat("  Observations:", length(ts_data), "\n")

# Stationarity test
cat("\n========== STATIONARITY TEST ==========\n")
adf_result <- adf.test(ts_data, alternative = "stationary")
cat("ADF Test p-value:", adf_result$p.value, "\n")
cat("Is series stationary?", ifelse(adf_result$p.value < 0.05, "YES ✓", "NO ✗"), "\n")

# Train ARIMA (FAST VERSION)
cat("\n========== TRAINING ARIMA MODEL ==========\n")

n <- length(ts_data)
train_size <- floor(n * 0.8)
test_size <- n - train_size

train_ts <- ts_data[1:train_size]
test_ts <- ts_data[(train_size + 1):n]

cat("Training set:", train_size, "weeks\n")
cat("Test set:", test_size, "weeks\n")

set.seed(123)
cat("\nFinding best ARIMA parameters (FAST)...\n")

arima_model <- auto.arima(
  train_ts,
  seasonal = TRUE,
  stepwise = TRUE,
  approximation = TRUE,
  max.p = 3,
  max.q = 3,
  max.P = 1,
  max.Q = 1,
  trace = TRUE
)

cat("\n✅ Best ARIMA Model:\n")
print(arima_model)

# Model diagnostics
residuals <- residuals(arima_model)
lb_test <- Box.test(residuals, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
cat("\nLjung-Box Test p-value:", lb_test$p.value, "\n")
cat("Residuals are", ifelse(lb_test$p.value > 0.05, "WHITE NOISE ✓", "CORRELATED ✗"), "\n")

# Forecast on test set
forecast_result <- forecast(arima_model, h = test_size)
forecast_mean <- as.numeric(forecast_result$mean)
actual_test <- as.numeric(test_ts)

rmse <- sqrt(mean((forecast_mean - actual_test)^2))
mae <- mean(abs(forecast_mean - actual_test))
mape <- mean(abs((forecast_mean - actual_test) / actual_test)) * 100

cat("\nTest Set Performance:\n")
cat("  RMSE:", round(rmse, 4), "\n")
cat("  MAE: ", round(mae, 4), "\n")
cat("  MAPE:", round(mape, 2), "%\n")

# 12-week forward forecast
cat("\n========== 12-WEEK FORWARD FORECAST ==========\n")

final_model <- auto.arima(
  ts_data,
  seasonal = TRUE,
  stepwise = TRUE,
  approximation = TRUE,
  max.p = 3,
  max.q = 3,
  max.P = 1,
  max.Q = 1
)

forward_forecast <- forecast(final_model, h = 12)

last_date <- region_data$Date[nrow(region_data)]
if(!inherits(last_date, "Date")) {
  last_date <- as.Date(last_date)
}
if(is.null(last_date) || is.na(last_date)) {
  last_date <- max(region_data$Date, na.rm = TRUE)
}

forecast_dates <- seq.Date(
  from = as.Date(last_date) + 7,
  by = "week",
  length.out = 12
)

forecast_table <- data.frame(
  Date = forecast_dates,
  Forecast = round(as.numeric(forward_forecast$mean), 3),
  Lower_80 = round(as.numeric(forward_forecast$lower[, 1]), 3),
  Upper_80 = round(as.numeric(forward_forecast$upper[, 1]), 3),
  Lower_95 = round(as.numeric(forward_forecast$lower[, 2]), 3),
  Upper_95 = round(as.numeric(forward_forecast$upper[, 2]), 3)
)

cat("\n12-Week Price Forecast for", region_name, ":\n")
print(forecast_table)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# PHASE 3B: MACHINE LEARNING MODELS (RANDOM FOREST)
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("PHASE 3B: MACHINE LEARNING MODELS\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# Prepare data for ML
ml_data <- model_data %>%
  select(-Date) %>%
  na.omit()

cat("ML Data dimensions:", dim(ml_data), "\n")
cat("Target variable: AveragePrice\n")
cat("Features:", ncol(ml_data) - 1, "\n")

# Prepare ML datasets
train_ml <- train_data %>% select(-Date) %>% na.omit()
valid_ml <- valid_data %>% select(-Date) %>% na.omit()
test_ml <- test_data %>% select(-Date) %>% na.omit()

cat("\nTraining set:", nrow(train_ml), "rows\n")
cat("Validation set:", nrow(valid_ml), "rows\n")
cat("Test set:", nrow(test_ml), "rows\n")

# Train Random Forest
cat("\n========== TRAINING RANDOM FOREST ==========\n")

set.seed(123)
rf_model <- randomForest(
  AveragePrice ~ .,
  data = train_ml,
  ntree = 100,
  importance = TRUE,
  mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(train_ml) - 1)),
  nodesize = 5
)

cat("✅ Random Forest trained!\n")
print(rf_model)

# Random Forest Evaluation
cat("\n========== RANDOM FOREST EVALUATION ==========\n")

rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_ml)

rf_rmse <- sqrt(mean((rf_pred - test_ml$AveragePrice)^2))
rf_mae <- mean(abs(rf_pred - test_ml$AveragePrice))
rf_r2 <- cor(rf_pred, test_ml$AveragePrice)^2
rf_mape <- mean(abs((rf_pred - test_ml$AveragePrice) / test_ml$AveragePrice)) * 100

cat("Random Forest Performance:\n")
cat("  RMSE:", round(rf_rmse, 4), "\n")
cat("  MAE: ", round(rf_mae, 4), "\n")
cat("  R²:  ", round(rf_r2, 4), "\n")
cat("  MAPE:", round(rf_mape, 2), "%\n")

# Feature Importance
importance_df <- as.data.frame(importance(rf_model))
importance_df$Feature <- rownames(importance_df)
importance_df <- importance_df %>%
  arrange(desc(`%IncMSE`))

cat("\nTop 10 Important Features:\n")
print(head(importance_df, 10))

# Feature importance plot
imp_plot <- ggplot(head(importance_df, 10), 
                   aes(x = reorder(Feature, `%IncMSE`), y = `%IncMSE`)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2E8B57") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest Feature Importance",
    x = "Feature",
    y = "% Increase in MSE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(imp_plot)

# Actual vs Predicted plot
rf_results <- data.frame(
  Actual = test_ml$AveragePrice,
  Predicted = rf_pred
)

rf_plot <- ggplot(rf_results, aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#2E8B57") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = paste("Random Forest: Actual vs Predicted (R² =", round(rf_r2, 3), ")"),
    x = "Actual Price (USD)",
    y = "Predicted Price (USD)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(rf_plot)

# Model Comparison
cat("\n========== MODEL COMPARISON ==========\n")

comparison_df <- data.frame(
  Model = c("ARIMA", "Random Forest"),
  RMSE = c(round(rmse, 4), round(rf_rmse, 4)),
  MAPE = c(round(mape, 2), round(rf_mape, 2)),
  R2 = c(NA, round(rf_r2, 4))
)

cat("Model Comparison:\n")
print(comparison_df)

if (rf_rmse < rmse) {
  cat("\n✅ Random Forest performs better (lower RMSE)\n")
} else {
  cat("\n✅ ARIMA performs better (lower RMSE)\n")
}

# Save ML model
saveRDS(rf_model, "rf_model.rds")
cat("\n💾 Random Forest model saved to: rf_model.rds\n")
```

```{r}
cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("PHASE 4: ARIMA EVALUATION\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

cat("========== MODEL PERFORMANCE ==========\n")
cat("Model:", as.character(arima_model), "\n")
cat("Training data:", train_size, "weeks\n")
cat("Test data:", test_size, "weeks\n")

cat("\nAccuracy Metrics:\n")
cat("  RMSE:", round(rmse, 4), "\n")
cat("  MAE: ", round(mae, 4), "\n")
cat("  MAPE:", round(mape, 2), "%\n")

if (mape < 5) {
  cat("  ✅ Excellent forecast accuracy (<5% error)\n")
} else if (mape < 10) {
  cat("  ✅ Good forecast accuracy (5-10% error)\n")
} else if (mape < 15) {
  cat("  ⚠️ Moderate forecast accuracy (10-15% error)\n")
} else {
  cat("  ⚠️ Poor forecast accuracy (>15% error)\n")
}

# Forecast plot
plot(forward_forecast, 
     main = paste("12-Week Forecast -", region_name),
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "Price (USD)",
     col = "#2E8B57",
     fcol = "blue",
     flwd = 2)

cat("\n========== 12-WEEK FORECAST ==========\n")
print(forecast_table)

# Seasonal Insights
cat("\n========== SEASONAL INSIGHTS ==========\n")

# Create seasonal summary
seasonal_summary <- region_data %>%
  group_by(month_name) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_price = mean(AveragePrice),
    min_price = min(AveragePrice),
    max_price = max(AveragePrice)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_price))

cat("\nAverage price by month:\n")
print(seasonal_summary)

best_month <- seasonal_summary$month_name[which.min(seasonal_summary$avg_price)]
worst_month <- seasonal_summary$month_name[which.max(seasonal_summary$avg_price)]

cat("\n📈 Seasonal Insights:\n")
cat("  Best month to buy (lowest price):", best_month, "\n")
cat("  Worst month to buy (highest price):", worst_month, "\n")
cat("  Price difference: $", 
    round(max(seasonal_summary$avg_price) - min(seasonal_summary$avg_price), 3), "\n")

# Business Insights
cat("\n========== BUSINESS INSIGHTS ==========\n")

price_trend <- ifelse(
  mean(tail(region_data$AveragePrice, 4)) > mean(head(region_data$AveragePrice, 4)),
  "UPWARD", "DOWNWARD"
)

cat("📊 Market Trends:\n")
cat("  Current price trend:", price_trend, "\n")
cat("  Current average price: $", round(mean(tail(region_data$AveragePrice, 4)), 3), "\n")
cat("  Predicted price in 4 weeks: $", forecast_table$Forecast[4], "\n")
cat("  Predicted price in 12 weeks: $", forecast_table$Forecast[12], "\n")

price_change_4w <- ((forecast_table$Forecast[4] - mean(tail(region_data$AveragePrice, 4))) / 
                    mean(tail(region_data$AveragePrice, 4))) * 100

if (price_change_4w < -5) {
  cat("  💡 Recommendation: BUY NOW - prices expected to drop\n")
} else if (price_change_4w > 5) {
  cat("  💡 Recommendation: SELL NOW - prices expected to rise\n")
} else {
  cat("  💡 Recommendation: HOLD - prices stable\n")
}

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("✅ PHASE 4 COMPLETE!\n")
cat("========================================\n")
```
